ruleDefinitions.name: 7Zip Compressing Dump Files
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects execution of 7z in order to compress a file with a ".dmp"/".dump" extension, which could be a step in a process of dump file exfiltration.

sequences.query: ((process_description = RGX(".*7\\-Zip.*") OR (process_path = RGX("\\\\7z\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\7zr\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\7za\\\.exe$")) OR (process_original_file_name = "7z\.exe" OR process_original_file_name = "7za\.exe")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.dmp.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.dump.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.hdmp.*")))
